utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m in for the repair drive, Dane. Tell me where you need me first.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m running a little late, but I can take door duty and sort the first round of tools.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No worries, I can cover the front and keep things moving until you get here.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it. I’ll bring the tools this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, just make sure you’ve got the ladder and the spare parts too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Will do. I’ve got the ladder and spare parts covered.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can bring over some tape, screws, and a spare wrench if you still need them.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, that would help a lot. I might already have a wrench somewhere, but I keep forgetting where I put things.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: If you find it, I’ll still bring the extra wrench just in case.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard there’s a repair drive coming up. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I’m a little worried about the timing and supplies. Tell me what parts need fixing, and I’ll see what I can manage.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Tell me the parts you’re low on, and I’ll help match that to what we can get in time.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Is the repair drive still on for Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard it’s still on for Saturday, but I haven’t seen the final details yet.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Have you heard when they’ll send the final details?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard the repair drive is picking up this afternoon, and folks are already dropping things off by the church lot.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can grab a few screwdrivers and my drill if anyone needs them. Glad to hear the lot’s filling up already.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds like a good turnout already—I'll let folks know you’ve got tools covered if they need them.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m spreading the word about the repair drive now, Opal. Come by if you can, and bring anyone else who might want to help.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll come by if I can, and I’ll check whether the lot on Maple still needs hands. If anyone’s heading over from Elm Street, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll send word to Elm Street folks too. See you at the repair drive if I can make it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with that. Tell me what still needs fixing, and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’re asking me to point out what still needs fixing, right?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, exactly — just point out what still needs fixing, and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Bo, I’ve got the repair drive on my list and I’m keeping it organized. Tell me what still needs attention, and I’ll line up the next steps.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, just the loose hinge and that front-step board still need a look. I’ll keep it quick.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve got it, Bo. I’ll put the hinge and front step board at the top of the list and keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can help with the repair drive. I’ll repeat the plan around and make sure folks know what’s next.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good. Keep it simple and let me know the next step when you’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll keep it simple: I’ll spread the word and let you know the next step soon.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive. I may have the details a bit mixed up, but I’m here to help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. I appreciate you helping with it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Absolutely, I’ll keep at it and help wherever I can.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help with that repair drive — what’s the plan so far?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ve heard it’s for the repair drive, but I don’t have the full list yet. I can check what’s still needed while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, thanks. If you can check what’s still needed, I can help keep track of the list once you’re back.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: You should come by the repair drive today, Dane - a few of us are already pitching in and I can save you a spot.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I might be a little late, but I’ll swing by soon and help out.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: No worries, we’ll keep a spot warm for you.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that if you want, but I’ll need a little more detail on what’s being repaired.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, tell me what needs fixing and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help if you let me know when the repair drive is happening. I need to work around school pickup times.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, I’ll make sure you get the date as soon as it’s set, and I’ll keep school pickup times in mind.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, I appreciate that. Just send me the date when it’s set, and I’ll plan around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Vik, I can help rally people for the repair drive if you want. Just tell me what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure, I can help. I’ll check what’s left and I’ll start rounding people up.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good, Vik. Keep me posted, and I’ll help with the rest once you know what’s left.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring over my drill and a couple of clamps if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would help a lot, but can you also bring the charger and tell me roughly when you’ll get here?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’ll bring the charger and aim to be there in about twenty minutes.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the map in mind; where should the repair drive start, Rosa?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Let’s start at the corner by the church and work our way down Elm from there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it, I’ll start at the church corner and head down Elm from there.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How much do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I can help, but I need the amount first. How much should I count on from you?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can give $20 for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with that, Cleo. Tell me what still needs fixing and I'll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a few small fixes left: a loose porch step, the gate latch, and one cracked window screen. If you can take a look at those, I’d be grateful.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can handle those three. I’ll start with the porch step and gate latch, then check the window screen after that.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard a little about the repair drive, but I’m still catching up. What’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Not much, honestly — I think they’ve started organizing the repairs, but I missed the latest details. I can check and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds good, keep me posted if you hear anything more.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, this repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s still on. I’ve heard they’re keeping the same time and place.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Good, I just wanted to make sure before I tell anyone else.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard they’re making real progress on the repair drive. I can check what still needs doing when I’m back from errands.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That would help. Thank you, Ira.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely — I’ll check what still needs doing and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive. I may be a bit mixed up, but I’m here to help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No worries, just keep it simple and we can sort the drive out together.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing, let’s keep it simple and get it done.
